mapper.select: SELECT la.id, la.lease_start_date, la.lease_end_date, la.rent, la.payment_type_id, la.status AS lease_status, la.source_type, ai.name AS apartment_name, ri.room_number, gi.name, gi.url FROM lease_agreement la LEFT JOIN apartment_info ai ON la.apartment_id = ai.id AND ai.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN room_info ri ON la.room_id = ri.id AND ri.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN graph_info gi ON gi.item_type = 2 AND gi.item_id = ri.id AND gi.is_deleted = 0 WHERE la.is_deleted = 0 AND la.phone = #{phone} ORDER BY la.create_time DESC

SELECT la.id, CONCAT(ai.name, ' ', ri.room_number, '房间租约') AS subject, COALESCE(la.rent, 0) + COALESCE(la.deposit, 0) AS amount_total, ai.name AS apartment_name, ri.room_number FROM lease_agreement la LEFT JOIN apartment_info ai ON la.apartment_id = ai.id AND ai.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN room_info ri ON la.room_id = ri.id AND ri.is_deleted = 0 WHERE la.is_deleted = 0 AND la.phone = #{phone} AND la.payment_status = 0 AND la.status IN (1, 2, 7) ORDER BY la.create_time DESC LIMIT 1
